caption:
Attended last nights preview event for @sedonataphouse newest location in Chester, VA with their grand opening today! They’re bringing elevated comfort food, crisp cocktail & warm hospitality 🤩

Cocktails I tried 🍸:
the sedona, T2T lemon basil and pomegranate blueberry 🫐 

Starters you need:
crab-stuffed mushrooms 🦀 and desert fire jalapeños 🌶️🔥

Mains & Favorites:
chuckawalla chicken 🐔, devil’s pass pasta 🍝 and kobe beef sliders 🍔 

Chester’s getting a big new player — if you’re into scratch-made dishes, friendly service and cocktails that taste crafted, Sedona Taphouse needs to be on your list ✨

Chester, it’s official! Our grand opening date is TOMORROW, Tuesday (11/25) 

Join us for lunch beginning at 11am or stop by for dinner and experience our award winning Happy Hour from 3-6pm!😁🍻

Hours for tomorrow are 11am-9:30pm.

We can’t wait to welcome you in to our shiny new space! Check out the menus and our weekly specials with the link in our bio now.

Day four of training our new staff and they are KILLING IT! 😆 

Watching a group of strangers turn into a little family is so magical. Our staff is the heart and soul of this place, and getting to spend a week laughing, learning, and teaching what it means to create an amazing guest experience is a special thing. 

This team has been working so hard and we couldn’t be more grateful! We can’t wait for you to meet them soon! 🥹❤️
